review_evidence: README describes a formally verified EVM smart-contract suite with Lean specifications and proofs.
Primary trees are explicitly split into src, spec, common, and proof modules for ERC20/ERC4626/ERC721/WETH, ownership, fixed-point math, sqrt/cbrt, and supporting correctness arguments.
The reviewed unit contains roughly 1192 formal declarations and no primary build-only file.
summary: Reviewed Tamago; all 44 primary Lean files are retained as smart-contract implementations, specifications, and machine-checked correctness proofs.
